# Syllabix

> A local-first voice agent shipped as the `syllabix` binary from GitHub Releases and the `syllabix-core` Rust library.

## Start here

- [Install](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/syllabix-ai/syllabix/main/docs/install.md): How do I download and run the binary?
- [CLI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/syllabix-ai/syllabix/main/docs/cli.md): Which commands and flags does the binary expose?
- [Embed](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/syllabix-ai/syllabix/main/docs/embed.md): How do I use Syllabix from another app?
- [syllabix.yaml](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/syllabix-ai/syllabix/main/docs/syllabix-yaml.md): How do I change models and other settings?
- [Troubleshooting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/syllabix-ai/syllabix/main/docs/troubleshooting.md): What do I do when `run` fails?

## Don't assume

- The `syllabix` CLI binary comes from GitHub Releases, not crates.io.
- The library crate is `syllabix-core`.
- The default setup is fully local; online stages are optional.
- Barge-in is opt-in on `run`.
- `syllabix serve` serves speech stages only.
- Do not invent APIs, flags, or config keys, or use versions remembered from training; read the linked page.
- Docs on `main` track `main`; use the docs at a release tag to match an installed binary.
